blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .
blocks.zh: 视频理解器通过可执行工具获取证据,该工具控制他们观察到的事物以及他们如何使用这些观测结果。 然而,行刑痕迹中只包含目前利用手段获得的证据,使得对失败的相互竞争的解释得不到解决,限制了自我改进的基础. 我们引入了Video-RSI,这是一个递归自我改进的框架,其中视频理解代理使用自己的语言模型来修改其控制装置. 通过积极的视频调查,该模型重温了原始的培训视频,以测试相互竞争的失败解释,并附加观察,为超出现有踪迹的证据的拟议更改打下基础. 成本意识的利用演化使这些诊断转化为可重复使用的修订,并通过考虑答案准确性和视觉成本来决定保留哪些修订. 在我们关于视频理解基准的评价设置中,进化的代理提高了准确性,同时处理的帧更少,并与现有的视频理解代理实现竞争性的准确效率权衡。 这些结果显示,视频了解剂有可能通过利用演化改进自身证据的获取和使用。 代码见https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video understanding agents must decide what to observe before they can decide how to answer.
In long videos, relevant events may be brief, temporally distant, or surrounded by visually similar distractions.
Recent agents address this challenge through iterative retrieval, temporal navigation, and tool-guided observation ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) .
At each step, the agent must choose where to look, which details to inspect, and whether the evidence is sufficient to answer.
These decisions are governed by an executable harness that controls evidence acquisition, processes observations, and supports subsequent reasoning.
The harness shapes both what the model sees and how it uses that evidence, linking answer accuracy to the cost of visual observation.
Improving this executable layer is therefore an opportunity to strengthen video understanding without changing model weights.
blocks.zh:
视频理解代理必须在决定如何回答之前决定观察什么.
在长视频中,相关活动可能短暂,时间遥远,或周围有视觉上相似的分心.
近期代理商通过迭代检索,时间导航,工具引导观测等手段应对这一挑战(王等,2024;张等,2025b;林等,2026).
每一步,代理人必须选择看哪里,检查哪些细节,证据是否足以回答.
这些决定由一个可执行工具来控制证据的获取,处理观察,并支持随后的推理.
牵引装置既塑造了模型所看到的事物,也塑造了模型如何使用这些证据,将答案的准确性与视觉观测的成本联系起来.
因此,改进这个可执行层是一次在不改变模型重量的情况下加强视频理解的机会.

blocks.en:
Automated agent design uses feedback to improve agent programs ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , and recent work extends code-level evolution to video understanding ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) .
Self-Harness further shows that a frozen model can revise its own operating harness in terminal environments ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
We study this form of harness self-improvement for video understanding. The language model that answers video questions also investigates failures and revises the code governing its behavior.
As shown in Figure 1 , adaptive evidence gathering changes what an agent observes within a question, while harness self-improvement changes the procedure it uses across subsequent questions.
This makes execution experience a basis for revising how evidence is acquired and organized, allowing useful changes to accumulate in the program.
Our objective is to turn execution experience into reusable improvements that increase answer accuracy while reducing visual observation, with the underlying models fixed.
blocks.zh:
自动代理设计利用反馈改进代理程序(Hu et al.,2025;Lee et al.,2026),近期作品将代码级演化扩展到视频理解(徐和陈,2026).
Self-Harness进一步显示,一个冷冻模型可以在终端环境中修正自己的操作控制装置(Zhang等人,2026a ).
我们研究了这种自我改进的方式 来理解视频。 回答视频问题的语言模型也调查了故障,并修改了规范其行为的代码.
如图1所示,适应性证据的收集改变了一种物剂在问题中观察到的情况,而利用自我改进则改变了它在随后的问题中所使用的程序。
这使得执行经验成为修订证据如何获取和整理的基础,使得程序中有用的变化得以积累.
我们的目标是将执行经验转化为可重复使用的改进,提高答案的准确性,同时减少视觉观察,同时固定基本的模型.

blocks.en: Figure 1: From answering video questions to improving the harness. (a) Direct MLLM inference uses supplied observations. (b) Video agents adapt evidence acquisition within a question. (c) Video-RSI uses the same frozen language model to investigate execution failures, revisit training videos, and revise the harness offline. Revisions are selected by accuracy and visual cost, producing a reusable harness for subsequent questions.
blocks.zh: 图 1:从回答视频问题到改进牵引. (a) 提供的直接的MLLM推论用途。 (b) 视频代理人在问题中调整证据获取。 (c) Video-RSI使用相同的冷冻语言模型来调查执行失败,重温培训录像,并修改下线的吊带。 修改通过精度和视觉成本来选择,产生一个可重复使用的工具,用于以后的问题.

blocks.en:
This objective requires both evidence for a revision and a criterion for deciding whether to retain it.
An execution trace contains only the observations acquired by the current harness.
A missing event may therefore reflect a sampling gap, a perceptual error, or a failure to use available evidence, each requiring a different modification.
For instance, an event absent from the recorded observations does not establish whether the agent failed to inspect it or misinterpreted what it saw.
Revisiting the video can help distinguish these explanations before the code is changed.
Yet correcting a failure does not necessarily produce a better harness. Denser sampling may improve an answer while increasing visual cost across many questions, whereas better evidence reuse may avoid redundant inspection.
Useful self-improvement must connect a supported failure diagnosis to an assessment of the revised harness’s accuracy and visual cost over complete executions.
blocks.zh:
这一目标要求有修订的证据和决定是否保留修订的标准。
执行跟踪只包含当前绳索获得的观测结果.
因此,缺失事件可能反映取样差距、感知错误或未能使用现有证据,每个情况都需要不同的修改。
例如,没有列入记录的意见的事件不能证明代理人没有检查或误解其所见。
重审视频有助于在代码更改前区分这些解释.
然而,纠正失败并不一定产生更好的利用。 Denser取样可以改进答案,同时提高许多问题的视觉成本,而更好的证据再利用可以避免重复检查。
自我改进的有用方法必须把支持的失败诊断与评估订正的装置的准确性以及相对于完全处决的视觉成本联系起来。

blocks.en:
We introduce Video-RSI , a framework in which the same frozen language model serves as both Solver and Editor to recursively improve a video agent’s executable harness. Active Video Investigation revisits training videos to test failure explanations and inform code revisions. Cost-Aware Harness Evolution evaluates the resulting candidates by answer accuracy and visual cost, retaining revisions that become the starting point for further improvement.
These mechanisms link evidence for what to change with criteria for which changes should accumulate.
The resulting loop can revise observation strategies and evidence-processing routines together, assessing their combined effect on the behavior of the complete agent.
Evolution takes place offline. The selected harness is then frozen for evaluation on new questions.
Across four video understanding benchmarks, the evolved harness improves accuracy while processing fewer frames than its initial version and achieves competitive accuracy–efficiency trade-offs against existing video agents.
On MLVU, active investigation also yields higher final accuracy than trace-only revision at similar inference-time frame usage.
blocks.zh:
我们推出Video-RSI, 这个框架由同一冷冻语言模型同时担任Solver和编辑, 积极视频调查重新审视培训视频以测试故障解释并告知代码修改. 成本效益进化通过答题精确度和视觉成本来评价产生的考生,保留成为进一步改进起点的修改.
这些机制将改变的证据与应该累积改变的标准联系起来。
由此形成的循环可以共同修改观测策略和证据处理常规,评估其对完整剂行为的综合影响.
进化发生离线。 然后将选定的带子冻结,以便对新问题进行评价。
在四个视频理解基准中,不断演化的利用提高了准确性,同时处理的帧比最初的版本少,并与现有的视频代理商实现了竞争性的准确性-效率权衡。
关于MLVU,在类似推断时间框架使用时,积极调查得出的最终准确度也高于仅微量修订。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for video harness self-improvement in which the same language model solves video questions, investigates failures, and revises its executable harness while model weights remain fixed. • We develop an improvement loop that links active video investigation to diagnosis-guided code revision and accuracy–cost selection, addressing both the evidence for a modification and its value for subsequent executions. • We evaluate Video-RSI across four video understanding benchmarks and analyze investigation and evolution dynamics, showing improvements over the initial harness in both accuracy and frame usage and the benefit of investigation over trace-only revision in the MLVU comparison.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们引入了Video-RSI,这是一个视频控制自改进的框架,在同一语言模型中解决视频问题,调查故障,并在模型权重保持不变的情况下修改其可执行控制带. 我们开发了一个改进循环,将积极的视频调查与诊断指导的代码修订和准确性——成本选择联系起来,既涉及修改的证据,也涉及修改对随后处决的价值。 我们通过四个视频理解基准评估视频-RSI,并分析调查和演变动态,显示在准确度和帧使用方面初步利用的改进,以及调查的好处,而不是对MLVU进行比较的微量修订。

blocks.en: We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for video harness self-improvement in which the same language model solves video questions, investigates failures, and revises its executable harness while model weights remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Video-RSI,这是一个视频控制自改进的框架,在同一语言模型中解决视频问题,调查故障,并在模型重量保持不变的情况下修改其可执行控制带.

blocks.en: We develop an improvement loop that links active video investigation to diagnosis-guided code revision and accuracy–cost selection, addressing both the evidence for a modification and its value for subsequent executions.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个改进循环,将积极的视频调查与诊断指导的代码修订和准确性-成本选择联系起来,既涉及修改的证据,也涉及修改的证据对随后处决的价值。

blocks.en: We evaluate Video-RSI across four video understanding benchmarks and analyze investigation and evolution dynamics, showing improvements over the initial harness in both accuracy and frame usage and the benefit of investigation over trace-only revision in the MLVU comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个视频理解基准评估视频-RSI,并分析调查和演变动态,显示在准确度和帧使用方面初步利用的改进,以及调查的好处,而不是对MLVU进行比较的微量修订。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Agentic Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 代理视频理解

blocks.en:
Video agents address long videos by deciding which evidence to acquire and how to organize it for reasoning.
Iterative retrieval and hierarchical representations allow VideoAgent and VideoTree to concentrate on question-relevant content ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , while VCA guides exploration with intrinsic rewards and a bounded visual memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
Beyond frame selection, document retrieval ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and multi-granular tool use ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) connect video observations to successive reasoning steps.
DVD combines global browsing, clip search, and direct frame inspection. VideoSeek provides complementary overview, skim, and focus operations.
MR.Video uses MapReduce to reconcile entities and aggregate question-specific analyses across segments ( Pang and Wang, 2025 ) , while LVAgent combines the observations and reasoning of multiple agents through dynamic collaboration ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
视频代理处理长视频的方式是决定获取哪些证据以及如何组织其推理.
迭代检索和分级表示使得VideoAgent和VideoTree能够专注于与问题相关的内容(Wang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b),而VCA则以内在的奖励和有界限的视觉记忆来指导探索(Yang等人,2025年).
超越帧选择,文档检索(Ma等人,2025年)和多角工具使用(Zhang等人,2025b;Lin等人,2026年)将视频观测与连续推理步骤连接.
DVD结合了全局浏览,剪辑搜索,以及直接帧检查. VideoSeek提供互补的概览,滑动,以及焦点操作.
师曰. 视频使用MapReduce调和实体,并汇总跨段的特定问题分析(Pang and Wang, 2025),而LVAgent则通过动态协作将多个代理的观察和推理结合起来(Chen等人, 2025).

blocks.en:
Another line of work learns observation policies through model training.
FrameThinker uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to coordinate reasoning with additional frame acquisition ( He et al., 2026 ) .
EVA further learns to allocate temporal windows, frame counts, and spatial resolution, and uses failure cases to guide the generation of additional training questions ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) .
Video-RSI instead keeps the underlying models fixed and evolves the executable harness that governs evidence acquisition and use.
Its improvement loop revisits training videos to diagnose failures before making program changes that apply across questions.
blocks.zh:
另一类工作是通过示范培训学习观察政策。
FrameThinker利用有监督的微调和强化学习来协调推理与额外帧获取(He等人,2026年).
EVA进一步学习分配时间窗口,帧计数,空间分辨率,并使用故障案例指导额外培训题的生成(Zhang等人,2026d ).
相反,视频-RSI保持了基本模型的固定,并发展了管理证据获取和使用的执行工具。
它的改进循环重温培训视频,以诊断失败,然后进行跨问题的程序更改。

blocks.en: 2.2 Automated Agent Design and Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 2.2 自动代理设计和自我改进

blocks.en:
Automated agent design treats the programs surrounding language models as an optimization space.
ADAS searches over agents expressed in code, while AFlow searches executable workflows ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
These formulations allow changes to the composition and control of model calls beyond isolated prompt edits.
Meta-Harness extends this direction by using historical code, evaluation scores, and execution traces to optimize harnesses around a fixed model ( Lee et al., 2026 ) .
This program-level view motivates our choice of an executable harness as the object of improvement, encompassing both evidence-processing tools and the logic that uses their outputs.
blocks.zh:
自动代理设计将围绕语言模型的程序视为优化空间.
ADAS搜索以代码表示的代理,而AFlow搜索可执行的工作流程(Hu等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a).
这些提法允许改变模型调用的组成和控制,超越了孤立的即时编辑.
Meta-Harness通过使用历史代码,评价分数,以及执行痕迹来优化固定模型周围的利用(Lee et al., 2026)来扩展这个方向.
这种程序层面的观点促使我们选择可执行的杠杆作为改进的对象,包括证据处理工具和使用其输出的逻辑.

blocks.en:
Self-improvement also concerns which system proposes the changes.
STOP studies an improvement program that modifies itself ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , and the Darwin Gödel Machine combines self-modification with exploration over an archive of agents ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
Self-Harness uses the same frozen model to propose harness revisions and validates candidates through regression testing ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
Video-RSI builds on this code-level self-improvement setting, with the same language model serving as Solver and Editor.
Our focus is the evidence available to that Editor. An execution trace records only what the current harness observed, so investigating the original video can distinguish failure explanations that would otherwise motivate different revisions.
blocks.zh:
自我改进还涉及哪个系统提出修改。
停止研究一个自我修改的改进程序(Zelikman等人,2024年),达尔文·格德尔机器将自我修改与对一个物剂档案的探索结合起来(Zhang等人,2026b).
Self-Harness使用相同的冷冻模型,通过回归测试提出对候选人的利用修改和验证(Zhang等人,2026a) 。 。 。
Video-RSI基于这种代码级的自我改进设置,使用相同的语言模型担任Solver和编辑.
我们的重点是该编辑所掌握的证据。 一次执行追踪只记录了当前机身所观察到的东西,因此调查原始视频可以区分出否则会引发不同修改的故障解释.

blocks.en: 2.3 Self-Evolving Video Agents
blocks.zh: 2.3 自演视频代理

blocks.en:
Video self-improvement has been explored through the generation and refinement of training signals.
EvoGround develops a proposer–solver learning loop for temporal grounding, Video-Zero organizes questioner–solver co-evolution around local temporal evidence, and EvoVid emphasizes temporal information in self-evolution ( Jung et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
These methods improve video capabilities through model training.
Video-RSI instead accumulates improvements in executable code while keeping model weights fixed.
blocks.zh:
通过生成和完善培训信号,探索了视频自我改进.
EvoGround为时间定位开发了一种建议者-溶解的学习循环,Video-Zero组织询问者-溶解地围绕当地时间证据共同演进,EvoVid强调时间信息在自我演进中(Jung等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年c;Huang等人,2026年).
这些方法通过模型培训提高了视频能力.
Video-RSI反而积累了可执行代码的改进,同时保持模型权重的固定.

blocks.en:
VideoHarness-RSI is a closely related approach to video harness evolution ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) .
It evolves context-construction programs that can coordinate retrieval, evidence representations, and auxiliary model calls around frozen vision–language models, and promotes candidates that improve validation accuracy.
Video-RSI shares this program-level search setting and focuses on how the Editor obtains evidence for a revision. Active investigation of the original videos tests failure explanations before code is edited.
Our selection rule also accounts for visual cost, admitting accuracy gains with bounded cost growth or cost reductions with bounded accuracy loss.
Together, investigation and selection connect reusable harness changes to their effects on answer quality and observation requirements.
blocks.zh:
VideoHarness-RSI是视频驾驭进化(徐和陈,2026)的一个密切相关的方法.
它演化了背景构建程序,可以围绕冷冻的视觉-语言模型来协调检索,证据表达和辅助模型调用,并促进提高验证准确性的候选人.
Video-RSI共享这个程序级搜索设置,并专注于编辑器如何获取修订的证据. 在编辑代码前积极调查原始视频测试失败解释.
我们的选择规则还考虑到视觉成本,承认有限度成本增长的准确性收益,或有限度的准确性损失的降低成本。
调查和选择将可重复利用的利用变化与其对答复质量和观察要求的影响结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 Video-RSI
blocks.zh: 3个视频新闻

blocks.en:
Video-RSI evolves the executable harness of a video question-answering agent while keeping the underlying models fixed.
An Editor revisits the original video to investigate failures, uses the resulting diagnosis to revise the harness, and submits the candidate to a performance–cost gate.
Accepted revisions become the starting point for the next evolution attempt.
Figure 2 provides an overview.
blocks.zh:
Video-RSI演化了视频问答代理的可执行工具,同时保持了基础模型的固定.
一位编辑重温了原始的视频,以调查失败,利用由此而来的诊断来修改套带,并将候选人提交到一个性能-成本门.
接受的修订成为下一个演变尝试的起点。
图2提供了概况。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of Video-RSI. The Solver and Editor share a frozen language model. Active video investigation revisits training videos to diagnose failures and guide harness revisions. Cost-aware harness evolution selects candidates using accuracy and visual cost on a private development set, carrying accepted revisions into subsequent iterations.
blocks.zh: 图2:Video-RSI概览. "Solver"和"编辑器"共享一个冷冻的语言模型. 积极的视频调查重新审视培训视频,以诊断失败并指导利用修改。 具有成本意识的进化利用在一套私人开发软件上使用的精度和视觉成本来选择候选人,对以后的迭代进行公认的修改。

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Evolvable Harness
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题拟订和变化中的利用

blocks.en:
A harness H H governs how an agent acquires and uses evidence to answer a video question.
Given a video V V , a question q q with answer choices, and fixed model services ℳ \mathcal{M} , the Solver produces an answer y ^ \hat{y} , an execution trace τ \tau , and a resource record c c : ( y ^ , τ , c ) = Run ⁡ ( H , V , q , ℳ ) . (\hat{y},\tau,c)=\operatorname{Run}(H,V,q;\mathcal{M}). (1) The trace records tool calls, observations, and decisions.
The Editor can jointly revise the harness code for prompt construction, tool implementation, observation processing, memory, and execution control.
blocks.zh:
H控制器控制着特工如何获取和使用证据来回答视频问题。
鉴于视频 V V,一个有答案选项的问题q,以及固定的模型服务 M\ mathcal{M},Solver 生成一个答案 y\ \ hat{y},一个执行追踪\ tau,以及一个资源记录 c c: (y , \\,\, c) = 运行\ (H, V, q, M) (\ hat{y},\ tau,c)\ operatorname{Run}(H, V,q;\ mathcal{M}). (1) 追踪记录工具呼叫、观察和决定。
编辑器可以联合修改用于即时构造,工具执行,观察处理,内存,以及执行控制等的带码.

blocks.en:
These components connect evidence acquisition to decision-making by determining what to inspect, how observations are represented and retained, and when to gather more evidence or answer.
Their coordination matters because even a correct observation can lose its temporal or entity associations before reaching the answering step.
Harness evolution can therefore change both the observations acquired and how they support reasoning.
blocks.zh:
这些组成部分将获取证据与决策联系起来,方法是确定检查什么、如何表达和保留观察,以及何时收集更多的证据或答复。
它们的协调很重要,因为即使是正确的观察也可能在达到回答步骤之前失去其时间或实体协会。
因此,合理性演化既可以改变所获得的观测结果,也可以改变它们如何支持推理.

blocks.en:
We use a training set 𝒟 tr \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{tr}} for investigation and revision and a fixed, video-disjoint selection set 𝒟 g \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{g}} .
Selection examples and per-item outcomes remain private to the evaluator.
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个训练集D tr\ mathcal{D}_{\ mathrm{tr}}}来进行调查和修改,以及一个固定的,视频-脱节的选择集Dg\mathcal{D}_{\ mathrm{g}} 。
选择实例和每个项目的结果仍对评价人员保密。

blocks.en: 3.2 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.2 框架概览

blocks.en:
Video-RSI uses the same frozen language model as Solver and Editor, accumulating improvements in executable code ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) .
At each attempt, the Solver executes H t H_{t} on training questions. The Editor examines its traces and revisits videos to test failure explanations before proposing a candidate H ~ t \widetilde{H}_{t} .
Independent evaluation on the private selection set determines whether the candidate replaces H t H_{t} for the next attempt.
Investigation occurs offline. Additional observations guide reusable code changes, while the selected harness answers subsequent questions using their own inputs.
blocks.zh:
Video-RSI使用与Solver和Editor相同的冷冻语言模型,积累了可执行代码的改进(徐和陈,2026).
在每次尝试中,Solver执行H t H_{t}关于训练问题. 编辑检查其踪迹,
对私人选择集的独立评价决定候选人是否取代H t H_{t}进行下一次尝试.
调查发生离线。 附加观测指南可重用代码更改,而选择的调用则使用自己的输入来回答后续的问题.

blocks.en: 3.3 Active Video Investigation
blocks.zh: 3.3 积极视频调查

blocks.en:
An execution trace may not reveal whether an incorrect answer stems from missing an event, misperceiving it, or failing to use existing evidence.
Active investigation lets the Editor revisit the original video to distinguish these explanations before revising the harness.
blocks.zh:
执行跟踪可能无法显示错误的答案是否来自事件缺失、误解或未能使用现有证据。
积极的调查让编辑重新审视原始视频,以区分这些解释,然后再修订绳索.

blocks.en:
The Editor examines training outcomes, traces, and code, prioritizing representative failures that additional evidence could clarify.
Queries vary the temporal region, sampling density, modality, or perceptual question to test competing explanations.
For example, denser inspection can reveal whether a short event fell between sampled frames.
The interface supports video observations, speech transcripts, on-screen text, and reruns of the unmodified incumbent. Perception requests omit the gold answer.
blocks.zh:
编辑审查培训成果、跟踪和守则,优先处理更多证据可以澄清的有代表性的失误。
查询会改变时间区域,采样密度,模式,或透视问题,以测试相互竞争的解释.
例如,更密集的检查可以揭示一个短事件是否在抽样框架之间掉落.
该接口支持视频观察,语音记录,屏幕文本,以及未修改的现任者的重播. 感应请求省略黄金答案.

blocks.en:
Let ℐ 0 \mathcal{I}_{0} contain the current code, training traces, available labels, and prior feedback.
The Editor selects queries u k u_{k} and accumulates returned evidence o k o_{k} : u k \displaystyle u_{k} = Query Editor ⁡ ( ℐ k ) , \displaystyle=\operatorname{Query}_{\mathrm{Editor}}(\mathcal{I}_{k}), (2) o k \displaystyle o_{k} = Investigate ⁡ ( u k , H t , 𝒟 tr , ℳ ) , \displaystyle=\operatorname{Investigate}(u_{k};H_{t},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{tr}},\mathcal{M}), ℐ k + 1 \displaystyle\mathcal{I}_{k+1} = ℐ k ∪ { ( u k , o k ) } . \displaystyle=\mathcal{I}_{k}\cup\{(u_{k},o_{k})\}. Each query specifies a training example and the observation needed to test an explanation.
The Editor interprets the accumulated evidence to choose the next query, while H t H_{t} remains unchanged.
blocks.zh:
让 I 0\ mathcal{I}_{0} 包含当前代码、 训练痕迹、 可用的标签和先前的反馈 。
编辑器选择查询 u k u_{k} 并累积返回的证据 o k o_{k} : u k \ displaystyle u_{k} = 查询编辑器\\ (I k) ,\ displaystyle\ operatorname\ eery\ mathrm{ 编辑器\ (\ mathcal{ I}_{k}), (2) o k\ displaystyle o_{k} = 调查 ⁡(u k, H t, D tr, M),\displaystyle operatorname{ Investigate}}(u_{k}; H_{t},\mathcal{ D}_{\mathrm{tr}},\mathcal{M}), I k + 1\ displaystyle\ mathcal{I}_{k+1} = I k → { (u k, o k ) } 。 \ displaystyle { mathcal{ I}_{k}\cup}(u_{k}, o_{k} {} 。 每个查询都具体说明培训实例和测试解释所需的观察。
编辑器解释累积的证据来选择下一个查询,而H t H_{t}则保持不变.

blocks.en:
New observations can support, contradict, or leave an explanation unresolved, redirecting subsequent queries.
Finding a missed event supports revising temporal coverage. If it was already observed, the diagnosis instead examines how its evidence was represented and used.
Investigation ends with a supported revision hypothesis or an unresolved case when no further informative query is available.
blocks.zh:
新的观察可以支持,矛盾,或者留下一个解释未解决,重新引导后续的询问.
查找缺失的事件支持修改时间覆盖 。 如果已经观察到这一点,则由诊断来检查其证据如何得到反映和使用。
在调查结束时,有一个支持的修订假设,或者一个没有进一步信息查询的未决案件。

blocks.en:
The Editor compares relevant cases to identify a reusable change, its applicable conditions, and successful behaviors to preserve.
Training annotations may locate informative intervals during diagnosis, but the revision must use cues available to the Solver on new questions.
The diagnosis therefore connects observed failures to a procedure for finding and using evidence without knowing the answer or event location in advance.
blocks.zh:
编辑对相关案例进行比较,以确定可重复使用的变化,其适用条件,以及保存的成功行为.
培训说明可能在诊断时找到信息间隔,但修订必须使用Solver掌握的新问题提示。
因此,诊断将观察到的失败与事先不知道答案或事件地点而发现和使用证据的程序联系起来。

blocks.en: 3.4 Cost-Aware Harness Evolution
blocks.zh: 3.4 成本效益演变

blocks.en:
The Editor maps the diagnosis to code changes, specifying when they apply and which successful behaviors to preserve.
Revisions can span the harness components in Section 3.1 , such as changing inspection cues or preserving temporal relationships in observations and memory.
A reusable change may require coordinated edits to a tool’s output and the code that consumes it.
The Editor can debug candidates through training-side trials, distinct from the pre-edit investigation, before submitting a candidate for selection.
blocks.zh:
编辑器将诊断图映射到代码变化,指定应用时间和保存哪些成功行为.
修订可跨越第3.1节中的控制部分,如改变检查提示或保留观察和记忆中的时间关系。
可重复使用的更改可能需要协调编辑一个工具的输出和消耗它的代码。
编辑可以通过培训侧式审判对候选人进行调试,不同于编辑前的调查,然后再提出人选进行选拔.

blocks.en:
After execution checks, the evaluator compares the candidate and incumbent on the same private selection examples under matched conditions.
It measures answer accuracy and visual cost, defined as mean frames processed by successful visual-model calls over complete question-answering executions.
This end-to-end assessment matters because a more elaborate tool can reduce later inspection, while a locally useful repair can increase overall visual usage.
blocks.zh:
在进行执行检查后,评价人员在相应条件下比较候选人和在职者在相同的个人甄选例子。
它衡量答案的准确性和视觉成本,被定义为通过成功的视觉模型电话处理的平均值框架,而不是完整的回答处决。
这种端到端评估很重要,因为更复杂的工具可以减少以后的检查,而当地有用的修理可以增加整体的视觉使用.

blocks.en:
Let A t , C t A_{t},C_{t} denote the incumbent’s accuracy and mean frame count on the selection set, and A ~ t , C ~ t \widetilde{A}_{t},\widetilde{C}_{t} the corresponding candidate measurements.
With Δ ​ A t = A ~ t − A t \Delta A_{t}=\widetilde{A}_{t}-A_{t} , the gate admits two improvement directions: g t = \displaystyle g_{t}={} [ Δ A t > 0 ] ∧ [ C ~ t ≤ ( 1 + α ) C t ] ⏟ accuracy gain with bounded cost growth \displaystyle\underbrace{[\Delta A_{t}>0]\land[\widetilde{C}_{t}\leq(1+\alpha)C_{t}]}_{\text{accuracy gain with bounded cost growth}} (3) ∨ [ − ϵ ≤ Δ A t ≤ 0 ] ∧ [ C ~ t ≤ ( 1 − β ) C t ] ∧ [ C t > 0 ] ⏟ cost reduction with bounded accuracy loss . \displaystyle\lor\underbrace{[-\epsilon\leq\Delta A_{t}\leq 0]\land[\widetilde{C}_{t}\leq(1-\beta)C_{t}]\land[C_{t}>0]}_{\text{cost reduction with bounded accuracy loss}}. Here, α ≥ 0 \alpha\geq 0 bounds relative cost growth, 0 < β < 1 0<\beta<1 sets the required relative cost reduction, and ϵ ≥ 0 \epsilon\geq 0 bounds accuracy loss. Their values are fixed during evolution and specified in the experimental setup.
If g t = 1 g_{t}=1 , the candidate becomes H t + 1 H_{t+1} . Otherwise, H t + 1 = H t H_{t+1}=H_{t} .
The Editor receives only aggregate accuracy and frame counts to guide subsequent revisions. Per-example gate traces remain private.
The selected harness is finally evaluated on held-out data.
Algorithm 1 summarizes the complete evolution process.
Algorithm 1 Recursive harness evolution in Video-RSI

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the long-video splits of Video-MME ( Fu et al., 2025 ) and LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) with subtitles, the official public subset of EgoSchema ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ) , and MLVU test ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
For evolution, we use 216 LVBench questions ( Wang et al., 2025a ) for investigation and revision, and another 72 questions as a fixed, video-disjoint development set for candidate selection.
Development examples and per-question outcomes remain private. The Editor receives only aggregate feedback.
blocks.zh:
我们评价Video-MME(Fu等人,2025年)和LongVideo Bench(Wu等人,2024年)的长视频分裂,副标题,EgoSchema(Mangalam等人,2023年)的官方公共子集,以及MLVU测试(周等人,2025年).
对于进化,我们使用216 LV Bench问题(Wang et al., 2025a)进行调查和修订,另外72个问题作为固定的,视频的不同步开发集,供候选人选择.
发展实例和每个问题的结果仍然保密。 编辑器只接收汇总反馈.

blocks.en:
The Solver and Editor use DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with Qwen3.6-Plus for visual observations. All model weights are frozen.
The initial harness H S ​ 0 H_{S0} supports global and local video inspection, transcripts, OCR, and observation memory.
We run 20 revision attempts using Eq. ( 3 ) with α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 , β = 0.2 \beta=0.2 , and ϵ = 1 / | 𝒟 g | \epsilon=1/|\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{g}}| , allowing at most one fewer correct answer in the cost-reduction branch.
The final accepted harness is frozen for the main evaluation, while intermediate accepted versions are evaluated to analyze evolution dynamics.
Active-investigation and trajectory-only variants share training examples, annotation access, initialization, models, and per-attempt resource limits, differing only in pre-edit access to new video observations.
blocks.zh:
Solver和编辑器使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro,其中Quen3.6-Plus用于视觉观测. 所有模型重量都冻结了.
最初的调用H S 0 HQQS0}支持全球和当地的视频检查,记录誊本,OCR,以及观察记忆.
我们使用 Eq. ( 3) 进行20次修改尝试,其中α = 0.1\alpha = 0.1,β = 0.2\beta = 0.2,和 β = 1 / | D g =\epsilon = 1/|\ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{g}}| ,在成本削减分支中最多允许一个更准确的答案.
最终接受的拉带被冻结用于主要评价,而中间接受的版本则被评价以分析进化动态.
主动调查和仅轨迹的变体共享培训实例,注释访问,初始化,模型,以及每一次尝试的资源限制,仅在编辑前访问新视频观测时有所不同.

blocks.en:
We compare with MLLMs, video agentic models, and harness self-improvement methods.
We reproduce VideoSeek ( Lin et al., 2026 ) and VideoHarness-RSI ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) using the same model (DeepSeek-V4-Pro) as Video-RSI. Results for the remaining methods are taken from their original publications.
The initial harness H S ​ 0 H_{S0} serves as the reference for evolution gains. Trajectory-only revision and an accuracy-only gate assess the contributions of investigation and candidate selection.
blocks.zh:
我们比较MLLM,视频代理模型, 并使用自我改进的方法。
我们转载VideoSeek(Lin等人,2026年)和VideoHarness-RSI(徐和陈,2026年)使用与Video-RSI相同的模型(DeepSeek-V4-Pro). 其余方法的结果取自其原始出版物。
最初的牵引装置H S 0 H_{S0}作为进化增益的参考. 仅审轨迹和仅审精度门评估调查和候选人甄选的贡献。

blocks.en:
We report multiple-choice accuracy and mean visual frames per question.
For our evaluations, frame usage sums all frames processed by successful visual-model calls during each complete execution, then averages across questions. Offline Editor observations are excluded.
blocks.zh:
我们每个问题都报告多种选择的准确性 和直观的画面
对我们的评价来说,帧使用总和是每次执行过程中通过成功的视觉模型调用处理的所有帧,然后是各个问题的平均值。 离线编辑器视图不包括在内.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 places Video-RSI alongside MLLMs, video agentic models, and harness self-improvement methods.
Our analysis focuses on the reproduced VideoSeek and VideoHarness-RSI implementations. Published results provide broader context.
With its harness evolved on LVBench and frozen for evaluation, Video-RSI achieves higher accuracy than both reproduced baselines across all four benchmarks, with lower frame usage in all but the VideoSeek comparison on Video-MME.
blocks.zh:
表1列出了Video-RSI与MLLMs,视频代理模型,以及自我改进方法。
我们的分析重点是复制的VideoSeek和VideoHarness-RSI的实施。 公布的结果提供了更广泛的背景。
Video-RSI在LV Bench上演化并冻结用于评价,其精确度高于所有四个基准的重复基线,除Video-MME的VideoSeek比较外,所有基准的帧使用率都较低。

blocks.en: Table 1: Video understanding results. Acc. denotes accuracy (%) and Frames denotes visual frame usage. Bold indicates column-best values. † \dagger denotes official M-Avg.
blocks.zh: 表1:视频理解结果。 Acc.表示精度(%),Frames表示视觉帧的使用. 粗体表示列最佳值。 —\dagger表示官方的M-Avg.

blocks.en:
Relative to VideoSeek, the accuracy–cost balance varies across benchmarks.
On MLVU, Video-RSI gains 4.8 percentage points while using 27.2% fewer frames, combining better answers with reduced visual usage.
On LongVideoBench, the main benefit is substantially fewer frames at similar accuracy. On EgoSchema, both accuracy and frame usage improve.
On Video-MME, higher accuracy accompanies a moderate increase in frame usage.
Thus, the advantage is not a uniform reduction in observation, but a favorable balance between answer quality and visual usage across different evaluation settings.
blocks.zh:
相对于VideoSeek,准确性-成本平衡因基准而异.
在MLVU上,Video-RSI得到4.8个百分点,同时使用更少27.2%的帧,结合更好的答案和减少的视觉用量.
在LongVideo Bench上,主要好处是同样准确的帧要少得多. 在EgoSchema上,精确度和帧使用率都有提高.
在Video-MME上,更高的精度伴随着帧使用量的适度增加.
因此,其优点不是统一减少观察,而是在不同评价环境中在回答质量和视觉使用之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.en:
Compared with VideoHarness-RSI, Video-RSI achieves higher accuracy with fewer frames on every benchmark.
The accuracy gain is largest on Video-MME, whereas EgoSchema shows closely comparable accuracy with substantially lower frame usage.
The evolved harness thus offers two practical benefits by improving answer quality and reducing the observations needed for comparable performance.
The controlled comparisons in Section 4.3 further examine how active investigation and cost-aware selection contribute to the resulting harness.
blocks.zh:
与VideoHarness-RSI相比,Video-RSI实现了更高的精度,每个基准的帧更少.
Video-MME的精度收益最大,而EgoSchema显示的精度相当,帧使用率低得多。
因此,经过演化的利用通过提高答案质量和减少可比较性能所需的观测结果,提供了两个实际好处。
第4.3节的控制下比较进一步审查了积极调查和成本意识选择如何有助于利用由此产生的手段。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en:
Table 2 examines how harness evolution depends on the evidence available before revision and the criterion used to retain candidates.
The trajectory-only variant restricts the Editor to existing execution traces, while active investigation allows additional video observations before editing. Both use 20 revision attempts under the shared conditions in Section 4.1 .
The accuracy-only gate variant examines selection without the visual-cost criterion.
We evaluate the resulting harnesses on all four benchmarks, using the initial harness as a reference.
blocks.zh:
表2审查了如何利用演变取决于修订前掌握的证据和保留候选人的标准。
只有轨迹的变体将编辑器限制在现有的执行痕迹,而主动调查则允许在编辑前进行额外的视频观察. 两者都在第4.1节的共同条件下使用20次修订尝试。
只有精度的门变体在没有视觉成本标准的情况下审查选择.
我们利用最初的利用情况作为参考,对所有四项基准进行评估。

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablations of active investigation and candidate selection. Acc. is accuracy (%). Frames is mean visual frames per question.
blocks.zh: 表2:积极调查和候选人甄选方面的不足。 Acc.为准确性(%). 框架是每个问题的平均视觉框架。

blocks.en:
Active investigation yields higher final accuracy than trajectory-only revision on every benchmark.
On MLVU, the gain reaches 8.2 percentage points with similar inference-time frame usage. On the other three benchmarks, higher accuracy accompanies fewer frames.
This pattern links additional evidence during offline revision to better deployed behavior without a consistent increase in inference-time observation.
The investigation-enabled run also retains five of twenty revisions, compared with three for trajectory-only revision.
Alongside the endpoint results, these observations support using evidence beyond the existing trace to guide reusable harness changes.
blocks.zh:
积极调查得出的最终准确度高于每个基准仅对轨迹的修订。
在MLVU中,收益达到8.2个百分点,使用类似的推断时间框架。 在另外三个基准上,更高的精确度伴有更少的帧.
这种模式将离线修订期间的额外证据与更好的部署行为联系起来,而不持续增加推论时间观察.
通过调查进行的运行还保留了20项订正中的5项,而仅按轨迹进行的运行则保留了3项。
除了终点结果外,这些观测结果还支持使用超出现有跟踪的证据来指导可重复使用的利用变化。

blocks.en:
The accuracy-only gate improves accuracy over the initial harness on all four benchmarks, but increases frame usage on three.
Video-RSI achieves higher accuracy than this variant while using fewer frames on every benchmark. On Video-MME, it uses roughly half as many frames.
Thus, the cost-aware run obtains visual savings without sacrificing endpoint accuracy in these evaluations.
The comparison shows why accuracy gains alone do not fully characterize a useful harness revision. Selecting for both objectives can retain more efficient behavior while preserving improvements in answer quality.
blocks.zh:
仅限精度的门提高了所有四个基准的初始控制器的精度,但增加了三个基准的帧使用率。
Video-RSI的精度高于这个变体,同时在每个基准上使用更少的帧. 在Video-MME上,它使用大约一半的帧.
因此,在不牺牲这些评价的终点准确性的情况下,对成本认识的运行可节省视觉费用。
比较表明,单是准确性提高,并不能充分说明如何进行有益的利用修订。 为这两个目标进行选择可以保持更有效的行为,同时保持答案质量的改善.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evolution Dynamics
blocks.zh: 4.4 演化动态

blocks.en:
Figure 3 tracks the retained harness over 20 revision attempts on the development set and MLVU.
The MLVU evaluations were performed retrospectively after evolution and did not inform candidate selection.
On the development set, the first accepted revision produces most of the net reduction in frame usage, while subsequent revisions steadily improve accuracy with smaller, nonmonotonic changes in visual cost.
The run thus combines an early efficiency gain with continued refinement of answer quality.
blocks.zh:
图3记录了20多次开发图集和劳动和社会保障部的修订尝试。
在经过演变后,对最低生活保障单位进行了追溯性评价,没有为甄选候选人提供信息。
在开发集方面,第一次被接受的修订产生大部分帧使用量的净减少,而随后的修订则随着视觉成本的较小的非模拟变化而稳步提高准确性.
因此,运行将及早提高效率与继续改进答复质量结合起来。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Evolution over 20 revision attempts. Accuracy and mean frames per question on (a,b) the development set and (c,d) MLVU. Curves track the retained harness. Vertical guides mark accepted revisions, and flat intervals indicate an unchanged incumbent.
blocks.zh: 图3:20次修订尝试的演变。 (a,b) 开发集和(c,d) MLVU上每个问题的准确性和平均值框架。 曲线跟踪保留绳索。 纵向指南标明已接受的修订,固定间隔表示在职者不变。

blocks.en:
The MLVU trajectory reveals that improvements on the selection set need not transfer at every step.
The first accepted revision reduces frame usage but lowers MLVU accuracy, despite improving both development metrics.
Accuracy recovers with the next revision, and the final two accepted revisions account for most of the net MLVU accuracy gain.
The final harness therefore reflects cumulative refinement beyond the initial efficiency improvement. An early development gain alone would give an incomplete picture of its evaluation behavior.
blocks.zh:
MLVU的轨迹显示,选择集的改进不需要在每一个步骤上转移.
第一次被接受的修订降低了帧使用率,但降低了MLVU的精确度,尽管这两个开发指标都有所改善。
准确性随着下一次修订而恢复,最后两部被接受的修订占了MLVU净准确性收益的大部分.
因此,最后的利用反映了在初步提高效率之后的累积改进。 仅靠早期发展收益就无法完整地了解其评价行为。

blocks.en:
Accuracy and visual cost also follow different paths during later refinement.
From H S ​ 2 H_{S2} onward, MLVU accuracy rises together with frame usage, yet the final harness remains more accurate and uses fewer frames than H S ​ 0 H_{S0} .
This pattern is consistent with the selection rule, which permits bounded cost increases for accuracy gains, rather than requiring frame usage to decrease at every update.
Later revisions can use more frames while retaining a net efficiency advantage over the initial harness, improving the final accuracy–cost balance.
blocks.zh:
准确性和视觉成本在后来的改进中也遵循不同的路径.
从H S 2 H_{S2} 继续, MLVU 的精度随着帧使用率的提高而上升,然而最终的牵引力仍然比 H S 0 H_{S0 } 使用帧更少.
这一模式符合甄选规则,该规则允许为准确性收益增加限定费用,而不是要求每次更新时减少帧使用。
后来的修订可以使用更多的帧,同时保留相对于初始控制的净效率优势,改善最终准确性-成本平衡.

blocks.en: 4.5 Analysis of Evolved Harnesses
blocks.zh: 4.5 演化分析

blocks.en: Comparing the initial harness with the retained revisions reveals three changes in how the Solver acquires and uses evidence:
blocks.zh: 将最初的利用与保留的订正相比较,可以看出Solver公司在获取和使用证据方面的三个变化:

blocks.en: Structured perception. In H S ​ 2 H_{S2} , free-form visual responses give way to goal-directed observations with structured findings, image references, and explicit uncertainty. The harness maps image references to frame timestamps, preserving the link between a finding and its temporal evidence. This interface lets follow-up reasoning target unresolved details and their supporting frames without changing model weights.
blocks.zh: 结构化感知. 在HS 2 HQQS2}中,自由形式的视觉反应让位于目标导向的观察,有结构化的发现,图像参考,以及明显的不确定性. 牵引装置将图像参考物映射为帧时间戳,保留了发现与其时间证据之间的联系. 这个接口允许后续推理在不改变模型权重的情况下瞄准未解决的细节及其支持框架.

blocks.en: Evidence reuse through relation graphs. Introduced in H S ​ 4 H_{S4} , the graph mechanism extracts entities, events, and relations from accumulated visual, transcript, and OCR observations. For eligible relational or temporal questions, it returns evidence gaps that can guide further inspection. Graph queries themselves process no new frames, making evidence organization an intermediate step between existing observations and additional acquisition.
blocks.zh: 通过关系图重新使用证据。 在HS 4 HQQS4}中引入,图机制从累积的视觉,文字记录和OCR观察中提取实体,事件和关系. 对于符合条件的关系或时间问题,它会返回证据缺口,以指导进一步检查。 图表查询本身没有处理新的框架,使证据组织成为现有观察和额外获取之间的中间步骤。

blocks.en: Selective observation routines. The Global-64 route in H S ​ 3 H_{S3} expands the initial 32-frame overview for selected whole-video questions. The occurrence tool in H S ​ 5 H_{S5} defines counting units, verifies candidate events, and consolidates overlapping evidence to avoid duplicate counts. These routines coexist with transcript-based localization and observation reuse. The final harness improves accuracy while using 10.8–44.1% fewer frames than H S ​ 0 H_{S0} across the four benchmarks, showing that richer observation tools can coexist with lower aggregate visual usage.
blocks.zh: 选择性观察常规. HS 3 HQQS3}中的Global-64路线扩展了部分全视频问题的初始32帧概览. HS 5 HQQS5}中的发生工具定义了计数单位,验证了候选事件,并合并了重叠的证据以避免重复计数. 这些常规与基于记录的本地化和观测再利用并存. 最终的拉带提高了精度,同时在四个基准上使用比H S 0 HQQS0]少10.8–44.1%的帧,表明较丰富的观测工具可以与较低的总视效共存.

blocks.en: These retained changes illustrate how evolution modifies both evidence acquisition and its use in reasoning. The reported savings measure visual frames rather than total model computation.
blocks.zh: 这些保留的变化说明演变如何改变证据的获取及其在推理中的用途。 所报告的节省计量可视框架,而不是总模型计算。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Video-RSI, a framework for improving video understanding agents through harness evolution with fixed model weights.
The same language model serves as Solver and Editor, revisiting training videos to test failure explanations and translating the resulting diagnoses into reusable code changes.
Cost-aware selection retains revisions according to both answer accuracy and visual usage.
Across four benchmarks, the evolved harness improves accuracy while using fewer frames than its initial version, with ablations supporting the contributions of active investigation and cost-aware selection.
Analysis of the retained code reveals changes in structured perception, evidence reuse, and selective observation.
Together, these findings support harness evolution as a practical route to improving how frozen-model video agents acquire and use evidence.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了Video-RSI,这是一个框架,通过固定模型重量的利用演化来改进对视频的理解。
同一种语言模型充当Solver和Editor,重新审视培训视频以测试故障解释,并将由此产生的诊断转化为可重复使用的代码修改.
具有成本意识的选择保留了根据回答准确性和视觉用法进行的修改。
在整个四项基准中,不断演进的利用提高了准确性,同时使用了比最初版本更少的帧,其中的模拟支持积极调查和成本意识选择的贡献。
对保留代码的分析揭示了结构感知、证据再利用和选择性观察的变化。
这些调查结果共同支持利用进化,作为改进冷冻模型视频代理如何获取和使用证据的实际途径。
